The controller tuning increases ki from 0.7 to 1.0 to enhance integral action, aiming to reduce steady-state error and smooth steering oscillations, while maintaining the previously effective kp=2.5 and kd=8 gains. The base_speed is slightly increased to 1.85 to push for faster completion time, building on iteration 3's success at 1.8 speed. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_right', which has yielded zero line loss events so far. Since this candidate has not raced yet, no direct performance data is available; the rationale is based on prior iteration evidence. If the next race shows improved completion time and stable or reduced steering oscillation, consider cautiously increasing base_speed further or fine-tuning ki and kd to optimize stability and speed. If steering oscillation or line loss events increase, consider reducing base_speed or adjusting kp and ki to improve control stability. Requested changes: 1) controller.ki=1.2 to test stronger integral action if oscillations persist; 2) controller.base_speed=1.8 if completion time worsens to regain stability; 3) controller.kp=2.0 if oscillations increase, to reduce proportional gain.
